name: New Hampshire

period.description: You choose a one-month or six-month spenddown period; to switch later you must reapply.

submission.description: Send or bring proof of your medical bills to your DHHS District Office. When your spenddown is met, the office gives or mails you a spenddown log.

notes: Current or past unpaid bills can count. The unused part of a bill can carry over to a later period.
Health insurance premiums, including Medicare Part B, count.
Report changes to DHHS within 10 days.
